idea: Themed weeks, week four, Markets day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor and a viewer editor before voicing.
description: On 31 August 2026, 8.5% of India's registered investors on NSE were recorded in Gujarat and 11.9% in Uttar Pradesh. But of the individual investors who traded in August 2026, 15.3% were recorded in Gujarat (19.9 lakh) and 8.8% in Uttar Pradesh (11.5 lakh).

Per 100 registered PANs, 17.2 traded in Gujarat against 7.1 in Uttar Pradesh, the highest of the ten states NSE lists; for October 2025 it was 19.6 and 8.9. A registered investor is any PAN registered with NSE, traded or not, and not only individuals; the state is set by PIN code. Those who traded are individuals, proprietorships and HUF who traded at least once in the month in the cash market, so the two counts differ. The map shows only the ten states NSE lists; NSE prints no figure for the others.
source: National Stock Exchange of India, NSE Market Pulse. Registered investors (distinct PANs, traded or not, not only individuals, state by PIN code): Sept 2026 Table 70 (31 Aug 2026), Nov 2025 Table 60 (31 Oct 2025). Individual investors (individuals, proprietorships, HUF) who traded at least once in the month in the cash market, top ten states: Sept 2026 Figures 329, 331 (Aug 2026); Nov 2025 Figure 395 (Oct 2025). Two different counts; two months.
